The blanks likely encode "Game Network EPG number 223 it launched Kingdom in May 2001," matching the note that Game Network launched on Sky channel 223 in May 2001. So the intended fill is "Game Network" for the first four blanks, "223" for the EPG number blanks, and "launched" for the "it ___ ___ ___ ___" blanks.  
CONFIDENCE: 55
